strings.The next or the previous control; the ar: Anath-smachd air adhart no air ais; gluaisidh na h-iuchraichean saighde taobh a-staigh earrainn
strings.Use the control that has the keyboard: Cleachd an smachd aig a bheil am meur-chlàr
strings.On the picture: move the picked mark (wi: Air an dealbh: gluais an comharra taghte (le Shift, deich piogsail)
strings.Show the ribbon's key letters: type one: Seall litrichean iuchrach an rioban: sgrìobh fear gus taba fhosgladh no inneal a chleachdadh
strings.Hold to see the ribbon tabs' letters; Al: Cùm sìos gus litrichean thabaichean an rioban fhaicinn; fosglaidh Alt agus litir an taba sin
strings.Capture your screen, mark it up, share i: Glac an sgrìn agad, cuir comharran oirre, co-roinn i.
strings.Or drop a picture file here, or paste on: No leig às faidhle deilbh an-seo, no cuir fear ann le {key}.
strings.Double-click to open. Right-click for ta: Briog dà thuras gus fhosgladh. Briog deas airson tagaichean is barrachd.
strings.Waiting for screen sharing…: A' feitheamh ri co-roinneadh na sgrìn…
strings.Recording steps: {count} so far: A' clàradh cheumannan: {count} gu ruige seo
strings.Draw on the screen and the preview; it s: Tarraing air an sgrìn is san ro-shealladh; chithear e san t-sruth is sa bhidio (Esc airson stad)
strings.Draw on the preview; it shows in the str: Tarraing san ro-shealladh; chithear e san t-sruth is sa bhidio (Esc airson stad)
strings.How long ink stays: Dè cho fada 's a mhaireas an inc
strings.Remove all ink: Thoir air falbh an inc air fad
strings.Open the Studio tab to draw on the scree: Fosgail an taba Studio airson tarraing air an sgrìn.
Air an deasg seo tarraingidh tu san ro-shealladh.
strings.Drawing. Press Esc to stop, Ctrl+Z to un: A' tarraing. Brùth Esc airson stad, Ctrl+Z airson neo-dhèanamh.
strings.Scroll it yourself, then press Stop: Sgrolaich e fhèin, an uairsin brùth Stad
strings.Couldn't save the tags: {error}: Cha b' urrainn na tagaichean a shàbhaladh: {error}
strings.Frame {number} is now a picture you can: 'S e dealbh a th' ann am frèam {number} a-nis air an urrainn dhut comharran a chur.
strings.Couldn't read the frame: {error}: Cha b' urrainn am frèam a leughadh: {error}
strings.Couldn't import presets: {error}: Cha b' urrainn na ro-shuidheachaidhean ion-phortadh: {error}
Chaidh an comharra a chopaigeadh. Cuiridh {key} ann e.
strings.Couldn't make the picture: it would be t: Cha b' urrainn an dealbh a dhèanamh: bhiodh e ro mhòr. Feuch le nas lugha dhealbhan no dealbhan nas lugha.
strings.Copy picture, paste a picture: Dèan lethbhreac dhen dealbh, cuir dealbh ann
strings.Save, save as, quick save to folder: Sàbhail, sàbhail mar, sàbhaladh luath gu pasgan
strings.New picture, open a picture, open the li: Dealbh ùr, fosgail dealbh, fosgail an leabharlann
strings.Print, pin picture to screen: Clò-bhuail, prìnich an dealbh ris an sgrìn
strings.Delete, shrink or grow the selected mark: Sguab às, crùb no meudaich an comharra taghte
strings.Fit, actual size, zoom in, zoom out: Co-fhreagair, fìor-mheud, sùm a-steach, sùm a-mach
strings.Ctrl+wheel, middle drag: Ctrl+cuibhle, slaod leis a' phutan mheadhanach
strings.R E O F P S H T change the shape, Space: Atharraichidh R E O F P S H T an cruth, Space = làn-sgrìn, Ctrl = an uinneag gu lèir
